infoPlist.NSContactsUsageDescription: FriendLend needs access to your contacts to help you quickly select borrowers when creating loans.
infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: FriendLend uses Face ID to secure your loan data and protect your privacy.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: FriendLend needs access to your photo library to let you add photos of borrowers.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: FriendLend needs access to your camera to let you take photos of borrowers.
infoPlist.NSCalendarsUsageDescription: FriendLend can add loan due dates to your calendar to help you track repayments.
infoPlist.NSRemindersUsageDescription: FriendLend can create reminders for loan due dates.
infoPlist.NSUserTrackingUsageDescription: This app does not track you.

plugins.contactsPermission: Allow FriendLend to access your contacts to help you quickly select borrowers.
